description: This file defines a Java interface named ClientDao which provides data access methods for Client objects, including retrieval, saving, and removal of clients based on their ID.

classes.name: ClientDao
classes.description: Interface for client data access object (DAO), declaring methods for retrieving, saving, and removing client entities.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Retrieves a Client object based on the provided client ID.

methods.name: saveClient
methods.description: Persists a Client object to the data store.

methods.name: removeClient
methods.description: Removes a client identified by client ID from the data store.
